title: A very solid app
body:
Tried a lot of these apps. This one came out on top. 

Why? Fast app start, no need for a login, easy and fast entrance, ability to skip. 

An app that knows what it is and doesn’t try to pretend.

title: Simple. Powerful. Life changing.

Only downside is that the pro version's price tag is a little too high.
